title: FluxPack
description: A vanilla-plus modpack with some backported features and animation+texture upgrades.
body:
A personal modpack for sharing with friends in a private server.

Generally vanilla-plus:
- Fresh takes on AI/mob animations
- Inventory management tweaks/sorting
- Expanded storage options via storage drawers
- Resource packs for aestetic tweaks
- Just Enough Items to facilitate item lookup and recipes
- Minimap/full-screen map via JourneyMap
- Mob heads with sounds
- Multiplayer support via voice chat and sleeping
- Dynamic lighting for light-emitting blocks/items
- Performance improving mods
- Utility/Config mods (e.g. BetterF3)

Credits:
Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/
